name: Java
description: Java 22+ over the Foreign Function & Memory API: no JNI, no dependency.
run_unix: javac -d build "{{RAVEN_BINDINGS}}/java/src/main/java/raven/R.java" src/Main.java && java --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED -cp build Main
run_windows: javac -d build "{{RAVEN_BINDINGS}}/java/src/main/java/raven/R.java" src\Main.java && java --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED -cp build Main
readme:
./run.sh        (run.bat on Windows)

The script compiles `src/Main.java` with the binding of the SDK (`raven/R.java`) and runs it with `RAVEN_LIBRARY` set. Java 22 or later.
